snippet.title: Forsaker: DingDing & Blade Launches September 24 on Steam!
snippet.description:
The brand-new visual novel Forsaker: DingDing & Blade is officially set to launch on September 24, 2025, at 10:00 AM CST on Steam!

✦ About the Game

In this tale of “devouring” and “being devoured,” you will embark on a journey full of choices:

Set in a tripartite world of Humans, the Divine Corpus Church, and Forsakers.

Two rustic youths’ seemingly routine mission spirals into a crimson odyssey, unveiling a cannibalistic game rife with conspiracies and moral crossroads.

Narrative: Over 200,000 words of script across three intertwining storylines. Can you piece together the ultimate truth of the world?

Combat: A roguelike deck-building system deeply tied to the narrative. Balanced for fun, with a “Lazy Mode” available for those who wish to enjoy the story stress-free.

Visuals & Sound: A hand-drawn art style that is both adorable and haunting, with nearly a hundred CGs. The atmospheric soundtrack complements the tale, creating a uniquely soothing reading experience.

✦ Release Info

Release Date: September 24, 2025, 10:00 AM CST

Platform: PC – Steam

⚔️ Add the game to your Wishlist now to get notified at launch!
👀 Follow us to stay updated with news and behind-the-scenes content.
